title: Host guidance on noContinuation omits that native relay mailboxes refuse it
outcome: An agent reading the host guidance or the acknowledge tool description knows that noContinuation is refused on native relay mailboxes, so it doesn't send a refused acknowledgement or conclude something is broken.
acceptance: src/coordination_instructions.rs and the termal_acknowledge_mailbox description in src/delegation_mcp.rs say native relay mailboxes refuse noContinuation, alongside the central-domain mailboxes they already name, and a test pins that wording; the refusal itself at src/mailbox_relay_routes.rs:682 stays as it is
